diff --git a/django/db/migrations/serializer.py b/django/db/migrations/serializer.py
index 7d226955d5..a3c4f41b3d 100644
--- a/django/db/migrations/serializer.py
+++ b/django/db/migrations/serializer.py
@@ -99,9 +99,35 @@ class DeconstructableSerializer(BaseSerializer):
             name = path
         return name, imports
 
+    def __init__(self, value):
+        self.value = value
+        self.value_class = value.__class__
+
     def serialize(self):
         return self.serialize_deconstructed(*self.value.deconstruct())
 
+    @property
+    def value_class(self):
+        return self._value_class
+
+    @value_class.setter
+    def value_class(self, value_class):
+        self._value_class = value_class
+        # If the class is nested, we need to use its qualname to build the
+        # correct import path.
+        if value_class.__qualname__ != value_class.__name__:
+            # The class is nested; build the full dotted path using qualname.
+            module = value_class.__module__
+            self._path = '%s.%s' % (module, value_class.__qualname__)
+        else:
+            self._path = '%s.%s' % (value_class.__module__, value_class.__name__)
+
+    def deconstruct(self):
+        # Override deconstruct() to use the correct path for nested classes.
+        path = self._path
+        args, kwargs = self.value.deconstruct()[1:]
+        return path, args, kwargs
+
 
 class DictionarySerializer(BaseSerializer):
     def serialize(self):
diff --git a/django/utils/deconstruct.py b/django/utils/deconstruct.py
index aa952f6b73..41b9f56630 100644
--- a/django/utils/deconstruct.py
+++ b/django/utils/deconstruct.py
@@ -27,10 +27,10 @@ def deconstructible(*args, path=None):
                 module_name, _, name = path.rpartition('.')
             else:
                 module_name = obj.__module__
-                name = obj.__class__.__name__
+                name = obj.__class__.__qualname__
             # Make sure it's actually there and not an inner class
             module = import_module(module_name)
-            if not hasattr(module, name):
+            if not hasattr(module, name.split('.')[0]):
                 raise ValueError(
                     "Could not find object %s in %s.\n"
                     "Please note that you cannot serialize things like inner "
